_comment: Curated manifest of corpus VN projects. Pinned to a specific commit SHA for reproducibility — collect_corpus.py updates the 'commit' field after each clone. The 'license' field is SPDX identifier ('MIT', 'Apache-2.0', 'GPL-3.0', 'BSD-3-Clause') or 'none' if no LICENSE file, or 'NOASSERTION' if GitHub cannot classify the license file (custom license — maintainer should verify). 'renpy_version' is null when not yet determined (planned: auto-detect via RenPyVersionDetector in a future release).

_schema.slug: short identifier, also the directory name under tests/_corpus/
_schema.commit: exact git commit SHA the corpus is pinned to

avnovel.notes: Audiovisual novel demo (~4 .rpy). Tiny project — smoke-tests minimal fixtures.

bytes_of_love.notes: BytesOfLove VN by ufosc (~29 .rpy). Student-built, university club.

cross_channel.notes: cross_channel Chinese localization (~302 .rpy). Largest .rpy count — broad coverage.

ddlc.notes: DDLC 1.1.1 decompiled (~35 .rpy). Real-world VN with heavy screen action / python use.

ddlc_mod_template.notes: DDLC mod template 2.0 (~40 .rpy). Community-standard mod scaffolding. TODO: no LICENSE file — verify permission to use as corpus or replace with a licensed alternative.

ddlc_mod_template_zchrxh.notes: Alternate DDLC mod template (~49 .rpy). Different idioms than Bronya-Rand.

learntocode.notes: Educational VN from freeCodeCamp (~60 .rpy). Large, well-structured, modern Ren'Py.

love69.notes: LOVE69 Ren'Py remaster (~29 .rpy). Localization-heavy, defines audio channels. TODO: no LICENSE file — verify permission to use as corpus or replace with a licensed alternative.

monika_after_story.notes: Monika After Story (~122 .rpy). Largest entry — long-running mod with complex state. NOASSERTION: GitHub cannot classify the LICENSE file (custom license) — maintainer should verify the license terms before public contributor invite.

personal_space2.notes: personal-space2 VN (~31 .rpy). Indie VN with translations. NOASSERTION: GitHub cannot classify the LICENSE file (custom license) — maintainer should verify.

renpy_template_ruolin.notes: Starter template (~11 .rpy). Small, well-commented reference code. TODO: no LICENSE file — verify permission to use as corpus or replace with a licensed alternative.

renpy_vn_template_dual.notes: Simple VN template (~10 .rpy). Minimal label/return structure.
